result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one truncated restaurant card and one partially visible category filter button.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen. The restaurant name is truncated and the card is only partially visible, giving no clear affordance that it's scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible scroll indicator or partial card peek with clear visual cue (e.g., shadow or arrow) to communicate horizontal scrollability. Also ensure the restaurant name truncation uses an ellipsis consistently and is readable.

issues.description: The last category filter pill (rightmost, after 'Healthy') is partially cut off at the right edge of the screen with no visible scroll indicator for the filter row.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient on the right side of the filter row to indicate more options are available via horizontal scroll.
